# Hash-pinned toolchain for the CI "ui" job (Playwright UI regression suite in
# tests/ui). Compiled from the project's [ui-test] extra (which also pulls the
# runtime dep airflow-pytest-operator), so `pip install --require-hashes -r
# requirements/ui.txt` + `pip install -e . --no-deps` yields a fully pinned
# environment. The browser binary itself is fetched separately by
# `playwright install chromium` (its version tracks the pinned playwright pkg).
# Universal lock: markers cover py3.10-3.13 and all platforms.
#
# Regenerate after changing the [ui-test] extra in pyproject.toml:
#   uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra ui-test --universal --generate-hashes \
#     --python-version 3.10 --no-annotate --no-header -o requirements/ui.txt
#
